items.title_zh: 小指罕见的额外折痕背后的奥秘；这是什么意思？
items.title_en: Mystery Behind Rare Extra Crease In Pinky Finger; What Does It Mean?
items.summary_zh: 1978 年进行的一项研究对 1102 个小指进行了检查，结果发现只有 4 个人的小指上有多余的折痕。
items.summary_en: Out of the 1102 little fingers examined in a study conducted in 1978, only four individuals had an extra crease on the little finger.
